import subprocess, sys, json, pickle
from pathlib import Path
p='/work/batch.py'
baseline=pickle.loads(Path('/work/.batch-baseline.pkl').read_bytes())
scenarios=['normal','mixed','partial-zero','empty','unknown','fail-fast','cancelled','live']
for s in scenarios:
    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,p,s], input=b'\n' if s=='live' else b'', capture_output=True, timeout=5)
    before=baseline[s]
    assert r.returncode == before['code'], (s, 'exit', r.returncode, before['code'])
    assert r.stdout == before['stdout'], (s, 'stdout changed')
    old_records=[json.loads(x) for x in before['stderr'].splitlines()]
    new_records=[json.loads(x) for x in r.stderr.splitlines()]
    assert len(new_records)==len(old_records), (s, 'record count')
    for i,(old,new) in enumerate(zip(old_records,new_records)):
        assert type(new.get('sequence')) is int and new['sequence']==i, (s,i,new.get('sequence'))
        stripped=dict(new); stripped.pop('sequence')
        assert stripped.keys()==old.keys(), (s,i,'existing fields changed',stripped.keys(),old.keys())
        # Durations are runtime-dependent; verify type/range while comparing every other old field.
        assert type(stripped['elapsed_ms']) is int and stripped['elapsed_ms'] >= 0
        old_elapsed=old.pop('elapsed_ms'); new_elapsed=stripped.pop('elapsed_ms')
        assert stripped==old, (s,i,'existing field value changed',stripped,old)
    print(f'{s}: ok (exit {r.returncode}, {len(new_records)} stderr records)')
# Verify the no-argument default remains normal.
default=subprocess.run([sys.executable,p], capture_output=True, timeout=5)
assert default.returncode==baseline['normal']['code'] and default.stdout==baseline['normal']['stdout']
records=[json.loads(x) for x in default.stderr.splitlines()]
assert [x['sequence'] for x in records]==list(range(len(records)))
print('default(normal): ok')
Path('/work/.batch-baseline.pkl').unlink()
